name: Random 3-SAT (10 variables, 48 clauses): annealing vs random walk
note: Generated with seed 2; three solutions (0001001001, 0010001100, 0010101100) among 1024 strings. Hill climbing from 0000000000 (h 44) stops on a plateau at 1000000000 (h 45 of 48). Over 100 seeds with 30 steps, simulated annealing (defaults T0 = 2, α = 0.9) finds a solution 51 times and the random walk only 7 times. Try seed 2 with 30 steps: annealing solves it, the random walk ends at h 46. Annealing prefers uphill moves but still accepts some downhill ones; the walk ignores h. The brute-force truth table is limited to 6 variables, so use DPLL, VND or beam search as a check.
